pairs.subject: agent-instruction-files
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/cli_process.rs:1044 spawn_cwd launches design-analysis (src-tauri/src/commands/design/analysis.rs:353) and review (reviews.rs:2858) agent sessions in the Personas process cwd with no ancestry bound, so they inherit whatever instruction files sit above it (in dev, this repo's operator CLAUDE.md) and the loaded set is never asserted

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/cli_process.rs:1044 spawn_cwd takes std::env::current_dir() as the agent workspace; spawn_temp (:1006) puts the rest under temp_dir, which on Windows sits under the user home, so neither path places the session outside an instruction-file span

src-tauri/engine/src/cli_mcp_config.rs:251 the sidecar install sweeps a stale config before writing and scrub_mcp_sidecar (:308) is called on every exit path, so the .claude/ file it creates names its reaper

pairs.subject: agent-instruction-files
pairs.evidence: src/api/devTools/devTools.ts:1604 the context is IPC pass-through (installSkill only forwards to skill_files_install); it neither authors nor delivers instruction content, and the install semantics are judged where they live (skill_files.rs under plugins-fleet-tests / resource-tracking)

pairs.subject: agent-instruction-files
pairs.evidence: src/features/fleet/monitor/grid/sessionHome.ts:3 the monitor only reads a session's cwd and run label to place it in a bay; no file in the context writes, loads or re-delivers a repo-owned instruction file
